library.enable_chapter_images_help: Extracting chapter images will allow clients to display graphical scene selection menus. The process can be slow, resource intensive, and may require several gigabytes of space. It runs as a nightly scheduled task, whose schedule is configurable in the scheduled tasks area. It is not recommended to run this task during peak usage hours.

library.chapter_images_during_scan_help: Generate chapter images when videos are imported during the library scan. Otherwise, they will be extracted during the chapter images scheduled task, allowing the regular library scan to complete faster.

jellyfin_import.title: Import from Jellyfin
jellyfin_import.help_intro: Bring over users, watch history and audio and subtitle choices from a Jellyfin server. Rustyfin only reads Jellyfin’s data folder.
jellyfin_import.help_mount: Make Jellyfin’s /config folder visible to Rustyfin, read-only. With Docker, add this volume to Rustyfin’s container:
jellyfin_import.help_path: Then enter /import/jellyfin below. Stop Jellyfin first, or import a copy of the folder, so its database doesn’t change during the import.
jellyfin_import.pairs_help: Each pair turns a Jellyfin path into the matching Rustyfin path, so items are found by their files.
jellyfin_import.unpaired: These Jellyfin library folders have no pair, so their items can’t be found by path:

playback_admin.hw_type_hint: Rustyfin decodes and encodes on VAAPI, QSV and NVENC devices. If the device fails to start, transcodes fall back to software until these settings are saved again.
playback_admin.vaapi_device_hint: The render node VAAPI uses, such as /dev/dri/renderD128.
playback_admin.qsv_device_hint: The render node QSV uses. Empty uses /dev/dri/renderD128.
playback_admin.crf_hint: 0 to 51. Lower is better quality and larger files. Software encodes use it under the bitrate limit.
playback_admin.temp_path_hint: Takes effect after a server restart. Empty uses the data folder's transcodes folder.
playback_admin.downmix_hint: AC-4 is saved only and downmixes like None. Dave750 and Nightmode Dialogue apply to 5.1 and 7.1 audio, RFC 7845 to 5.1.
playback_admin.enable_tonemapping: Tone map HDR10 and HLG video to SDR
playback_admin.tonemapping_hint: Tone mapping runs in software (zscale), also when hardware acceleration is on. BT.2390 runs as Hable.
playback_admin.throttling_hint: These are saved for Jellyfin clients. Rustyfin's transcoder doesn't throttle or delete segments yet.
playback_admin.resume_hint: These are saved for Jellyfin clients. Rustyfin's server still uses Jellyfin's defaults (5%, 90%, 300 seconds).
playback_admin.remote_bitrate_hint: 0 is no limit. Each user's own limit is in the user editor.
playback_admin.load_failed: The playback settings could not be loaded
playback_admin.error_crf: The CRF values must be whole numbers from 0 to 51.
playback_admin.error_resume: The minimum resume percentage must be below the maximum.
playback_admin.error_encoding: Nothing was saved: the transcoding settings were refused ({{error}}).
playback_admin.error_config: The transcoding settings were saved, but the resume and streaming settings were not ({{error}}).
